Nullsolve

A floating AI panel for any page. Drag the button onto your bookmarks bar.

Bake in your key (optional)

Fill these in and the bookmarklet carries them, so the panel is ready on every site instead of asking per domain. Leave them blank for a plain build you configure inside the panel.

Create one at aistudio.google.com/apikey.
Built-in list. Load from your key to see exactly what it can use.
Nullsolve

Setup

  1. Show your bookmarks bar (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + B) and drag the button onto it.
  2. Open any normal website and click the bookmark.
  3. Type a message. Your browser asks to share the screen once, then every message carries a fresh screenshot.

If you did not bake a key in, open the gear and paste one there. Keys entered in the panel are stored per site, so a baked-in key saves repeating that on every domain. Requests go straight from your browser to Google.
